Douglas Blvd., Midwest City. Oklahoma County shall provide labor, equipment, and materials for the project in an amount not to exceed Thirty Thousand Four Hundred Eighty-Four Dollars and Eighty-Three Cents ($30,484.83). Upon completion of the project and receipt of invoicing from the County, the City of Midwest City shall reimburse Oklahoma County for 100% of the costs of labor, equipment, and materials in an amount not to exceed Thirty Thousand Four Hundred Eighty-Four Dollars and Eighty-Three Cents ($30,484.83). This Agreement shall become effective upon execution by both parties and shall terminate on June 30, 2027. Requested by Jason Lowe, Commissioner, District One.
